name: gainControlToContinuous
signature: export function gainControlToContinuous(effect: Extract<Effect, { do: 'gain-control' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
contract: Produces one ContinuousEffect at sublayer 2a naming the new controller as a concrete PlayerId, never a PlayerSelector.
Declares `provides: ['control-change']` so CR 613.8 dependency ordering can see it.
An unresolvable controller produces no effect and one deferred line.
Emits zero GameActions: control change is a layer, not a state write.

assertions.given: Act of Treason on an opponent's creature
assertions.expect: one 2a control effect naming this player's id
the creature's controller reads as the thief
no effect and one deferred line
